title: I to V in F major
trains: From the home chord (I) to the chord on the fifth note (V) with the least movement: finger 5 keeps the top note and the other two move down a step (fingers 1 and 2), so V stands on its third (in C: G stays, C to B, E to D: G/B). The left hand steps down a half step too.
